title: Day 74: 'El Cabo' (CJNG Forced-Recruiter, Rancho Izaguirre) Arrested in Ciudad Acuña, Coahuila — Teuchitlán Extermination Network Continues to Collapse
detail: Day 74 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). ENFORCEMENT UPDATE — 'EL CABO' ARRESTED (May 7, 2026): Mexico's FGR (Fiscalía General de la República) announced the arrest of Fernando Daniel Farías de la Cruz, alias 'El Cabo,' a CJNG operative with documented ties to the Rancho Izaguirre / 'La Galera' compound in Teuchitlán, Jalisco — the same property identified as a site of forced recruitment, sicario training, and mass enforced disappearances under El Sapo's CJNG military faction. El Cabo was captured at a property in Ciudad Acuña, Coahuila (approximately 1,100 km northeast of Teuchitlán) by the AIC (Agencia de Investigación Criminal — Criminal Investigation Agency). Charges: crimes against health (delitos contra la salud), enforced disappearances (desaparición forzada), and organized crime/human trafficking. He was transferred to the Federal Criminal Justice Center (CEFERESO) in Puente Grande, Jalisco for initial proceedings. SIGNIFICANCE — TEUCHITLÁN NETWORK COLLAPSE: The Rancho Izaguirre / 'La Galera' compound in Teuchitlán had previously been identified by FGR as CJNG's primary sicario training facility, with forensic investigation ongoing as of April 2026 — nearly 100 DNA samples obtained, bone fragments identified predating 2015. El Cabo's role as a recruiter — the operational entry point of the forced-disappearance pipeline — makes his arrest significant beyond its military rank. His capture follows the broader post-El Jardinero enforcement trajectory targeting CJNG's mid-tier operational infrastructure rather than only top command figures. The Teuchitlán arrest pipeline now covers: El Jardinero (El Sapo's military faction commander, arrested April 27) → El Güero Conta (financial operator, arrested April 27) → El Cabo (recruiter for the same training infrastructure, arrested May 7). SUCCESSION CONTEXT (Day 74): The El 03 vs. El Sapo binary persists; El Sapo remains at large as Mexico's top CJNG enforcement priority (Federal Security Cabinet, May 3). The State Department began a review of all 53 Mexican consulates in the U.S. amid escalating bilateral tensions — tracking the combined CIA Chihuahua sovereignty crisis, DOJ Rocha Moya indictment, and Sheinbaum's May 6 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard. 35 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Mexico City).
